mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing mexiletine metabolism and increasing serum concentrations, while both drugs have CNS depressant effects and mexiletine may increase valproic acid levels through protein binding displacement.
action: Monitor mexiletine levels and cardiac function; consider mexiletine dose reduction if co-administered; assess for increased CNS and cardiac adverse effects.
